observations: Photo shows two red game cases/boxes on a patterned floor.
No accessories (cables, headset, charging dock, etc.) are visible.
Text on the boxes is not clearly readable enough to confirm game titles or platform.

claims.claim: Customized PS4 big, with 2 pads, 7 games and complete accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows two red game cases/boxes; it does not show a PS4 console, controllers, or accessories, and only 2 game items are visible.

risks.risk: The item may not be a PS4 (or may not be the 'big' model) even though the seller claims it.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual PS4 console showing the front ports/label and model markings (or the console powered on with the system screen).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed PS4 (worst case: treat as games-only / not the console).

risks.risk: Controllers may be missing, non-functional, or not included as claimed (2 pads).
risks.proof: Photos of both controllers (front/back) plus a short clip showing them pairing/working on the console.

risks.risk: Game count may be less than 7, or games may be for the wrong platform/region.
risks.proof: A photo lineup showing all game cases/discs (count = 7) with readable titles, or a screenshot of the library on the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as only the visible games (worst case: treat as 2 games).

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (missing power cable, HDMI, charging cable, etc.).
risks.proof: A single photo showing every accessory laid out (power cable, HDMI, USB/charging, headset if any) with close-ups of connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete accessories (worst case: assume missing key cables).

risks.risk: Console may be faulty (won’t power on, overheating, disc drive issues, controller ports issues).
risks.proof: A short video clip: power on → home screen → insert a disc (or launch a game) showing it runs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / untested until proven.

proof_requests: Photo of the PS4 console itself (front + back label/model) and a powered-on screen.
Photos of both controllers (front/back) and a clip showing they connect and respond.
Photo showing all 7 games clearly (or a console library screenshot) with readable titles.
Photo of all accessories laid out together (power, HDMI, cables) with close-ups of connectors.
Short test video: boot to home screen and run one game.
response.reason: The current photo only shows two game cases and does not confirm the PS4 console, the two controllers, the full set of 7 games, or the accessories. Without these, a worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
